title: Warm Velvety Mexican Chicken Huaraches
description: A sweet and velvety weeknight Mexican dish featuring lemon zest and shio-koji-cure, perfect for a quick dinner, and egg-free-friendly in the form of huaraches.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-koji, lemon zest, and a pinch of salt.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the shio-koji mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the huaraches by placing a portion of the chicken and onion mixture onto a tortilla, topping with cheese and folding the tortilla in half.
Place the huaraches on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the tortillas are crispy.
Serve the huaraches hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and a dollop of sour cream.
